title: Finite separable extension splitting the generic components
statement: Let k be a field, and let f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k be finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. There exist a field extension L/k [def-pc-field-extension] and its spectrum map y:\operatorname{Spec}L\to\operatorname{Spec}k, finite (affine locally its coordinate algebra is a finite module) and etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], such that every irreducible component C [def-weil-irreducible-components] of G=X\times_k L [def-pc-fibre-product] is geometrically irreducible [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]: for every field E and morphism z:\operatorname{Spec}E\to\operatorname{Spec}L, the inverse image of C under G\times_L E\to G is irreducible and nonempty. No open of any other base and no special-fibre cover is asserted.

proof.text: Base change f to the spectrum of SeparableClosure k. This pullback is locally noetherian by finite type over a field and compact by quasi-compactness. Apply finite_irreducibleComponents_of_isNoetherian to get the finite-component hypothesis.
Apply lem-sbc-components-finite-separable-descent to choose a finite intermediate field L whose every component has a single component as inverse image over the separable closure.

The intermediate field is separable over k. The spectrum map is finite by IsFinite.SpecMap_iff and finite_algebraMap; it is etale by Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isSeparable and finite presentation of a finite type algebra over the noetherian field k.

For each component A of X_L, the descent statement gives an irreducible nonempty inverse image over the separable closure. Apply lem-sbc-subset-geometric-irreducibility to the structure map of X_L and the subset A to obtain the asserted inverse-image irreducibility for every test field. No reduced closed subscheme or topology transport through such a subscheme is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_etale_geometric_component_extension {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L)
      (y : Spec (CommRingCat.of L) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)),
      IsFinite y ∧ Etale y ∧
      ∀ A ∈ irreducibleComponents ↥(pullback f y),
        ∀ (E : Type u) (_ : Field E) (z : Spec (CommRingCat.of E) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)),
          IsIrreducible ((pullback.fst (pullback.snd f y) z) ⁻¹' A)
